item.title: [LU-20495] use-after-free panic in lmv_qos_exclude() when mkdir races qos_exclude_patterns update
item.description:
Reproduced on master, 2-MDT DNE client:

lfs setdirstripe -D -i -1 -c 1 --max-inherit-rr=-1 /mnt/lustre/d
lctl set_param lmv.*.qos_threshold_rr=100
  # in parallel:
  #  A) 8x tight mkdir loops under /mnt/lustre/d
  #  B) tight loop: lctl set_param lmv.*.qos_exclude_patterns="<long list>"
  -> client panics within seconds
